criteria.criterion: Output follows the type(scope): summary Conventional Commits format
criteria.evidence: All 6 outputs match the pattern exactly, e.g. eval-0 runs 1-3: 'feat(auth): add jwt login endpoint'; eval-1 runs 1-3: 'fix(profile): add null check for user profile image', 'fix(profile): handle missing profile image', 'fix(profile): prevent null pointer crash for missing profile images'.

criteria.criterion: Commit type is drawn from the skill's allowed set (feat, fix, docs, refactor, test, chore, perf, build, ci)
criteria.evidence: eval-0 (JWT login endpoint addition) used 'feat' in all 3 runs, matching the expected type for a new feature; eval-1 (null-pointer crash fix) used 'fix' in all 3 runs, matching the expected type for a bug fix.

criteria.criterion: Summary is written in lowercase, with no capitalized first word
criteria.evidence: All 6 summaries start lowercase: 'add jwt login endpoint', 'add null check for user profile image', 'handle missing profile image', 'prevent null pointer crash for missing profile images'; none capitalize the first letter.
None of the 6 outputs end with a period, e.g. 'feat(auth): add jwt login endpoint' and 'fix(profile): prevent null pointer crash for missing profile images' both end cleanly without punctuation.

criteria.criterion: Summary is phrased in the imperative mood (command form, not past tense or gerund-as-verb)
criteria.evidence: All summaries open with a bare imperative verb: 'add jwt login endpoint', 'add null check...', 'handle missing profile image', 'prevent null pointer crash...' — none use past tense ('added', 'fixed') despite the prompts themselves being phrased in past tense.

criteria.criterion: Output contains only the commit message line, with no extra commentary, headers, or explanation
criteria.evidence: Every one of the 6 run outputs is a single bare line with nothing else (e.g. eval-0 run-1 file contains only 'feat(auth): add jwt login endpoint'); none include preamble like 'Here is the commit message:' or trailing notes, consistent with the skill's instruction 'Output ONLY the commit message line, nothing else.'
